raw.description: This resort is facing the sea, on the outskirts of the hotel zone of Cancun. The All Ritmo Canc\u00FAn Resort & Waterpark is the perfect place to enjoy an unforgettable family vacation in Canc\u00FAn. With a 100% Mexican atmosphere, this all-inclusive resort offers an adrenaline-filled water park, free Wi-Fi in common areas, spa service for your relaxation, and free parking. With a strategic location north of the city, you will be just 5 minutes by car from the El Meco Archaeological Zone and the Gran Puerto Pier, and just 7.1 km from Plaza Las Am\u00E9ricas. All Ritmo Canc\u00FAn Resort & Waterpark - All Inclusive features satellite TV and a coffee maker in every air-conditioned guest room. The private bathroom is equipped with a bathtub\/shower combination. Guests can use the oceanfront swimming pool or one of the 3 hot tubs at the All Ritmo. A children's club offering supervised activities is offered. Non-motorized water sports, a soccer field and mini golf course are available. The all-inclusive program at the All Ritmo Canc\u00FAn Resort & Waterpark - All Inclusive includes all meals, snacks and beverages. A daily activities program and nightly entertainment are provided for adults and children. El Palmar is a buffet-style restaurant that is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Ostras & Oysters serves international cuisine for dinner. Reservations required. La Terraza Snack offers snacks and light meals for lunch and dinner.

This is a business and family-centered hotel only a couple of miles from the Convention Center. It offers both an All-Inclusive lodging option and a European Plan. This air-conditioned hotel is 20 minutes from Cancun International Airport and has 249 guestrooms available. All rooms at this hotel are spacious four-star rooms with the security and comfort that guests want. Each room comes with a television, telephone, and complimentary high-speed wireless Internet. There is a hairdryer, dressing table, and a private bathroom with the needed amenities. Room service, laundry service, and wake-up calls are available and rooms come with a safety deposit box. There are several on-site dining options started with La Fuente Restaurant which is on the ground floor and offers an International buffet spread. Another choice is Albatros Restaurant which is beachside and specializes in lobster dishes and ceviche. There is also a pool bar by the main pool where guests can order burgers, milkshakes, and other snacks. Don Roberto’s Bar & Pizza serves pizza and beverages near the swimming pool while Palenque Lobby Bar serves beer, wine, and cocktails. When it’s time to have fun, Flamingo Cancun Resort has two swimming pools, a fitness center, Jacuzzi, kids’ club, temazcal, and a massage area. There are also many water and land sports to take part in like volleyball and kayaking. The hotel also hosts night shows for an extra dose of entertainment.
